title: Depth pass 1
question: For each kind, does our showcase game come within reach of a reference game the creator names, judged blind by players, and what does the creator say when they play it?
order: The kinds breadth can already build go first (DESIGN, "Cadence"). The order is set in the pass's plan.json, not here.
build: Each showcase is built through the whole loop from its prompt, with the whole ladder: the strong model, specialist rounds for art, feel and netcode, generated and hand-made art, as many rounds as it takes. No budget.

measures.clarity: I always knew what to do and what was happening.
measures.feel: Moving, acting and getting hit felt good under my hands.
measures.look: It looked good while it was moving.
measures.again: I would play it again with friends.

panel.who: people who have not seen our game, are not on the team, and do not know which game is ours
panel.together: when both games are multiplayer, players play in pairs; the same count plays both games

screen.where: the creator's 4K screen on this machine, both games full screen, in motion

withinReach: A measure is within reach when the mean over players of (our score - the reference's score) is at least -1.0.
exit: Per slot: the creator's verdict in their own words, recorded verbatim in a new evidence file; and the blind scores within reach on at least 3 of the 4 measures.
